mapper.select: SELECT sr.id, sr.student_id, sr.song_name, sr.singer, sr.message, sr.status, sr.audit_time, sr.play_time, sr.create_time, u.real_name as student_name, u.student_id as student_no, u.username FROM song_request sr LEFT JOIN user u ON sr.student_id = u.id ORDER BY sr.create_time DESC

SELECT sr.id, sr.student_id, sr.song_name, sr.singer, sr.message, sr.status, sr.audit_time, sr.play_time, sr.create_time, u.real_name as student_name, u.student_id as student_no, u.username, u.phone, u.email FROM song_request sr LEFT JOIN user u ON sr.student_id = u.id WHERE sr.id = #{id}

SELECT sr.id, sr.student_id, sr.song_name, sr.singer, sr.message, sr.status, sr.audit_time, sr.play_time, sr.create_time, u.real_name as student_name, u.student_id as student_no FROM song_request sr LEFT JOIN user u ON sr.student_id = u.id WHERE sr.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY sr.create_time DESC

SELECT sr.id, sr.student_id, sr.song_name, sr.singer, sr.message, sr.status, sr.audit_time, sr.play_time, sr.create_time, u.real_name as student_name, u.student_id as student_no FROM song_request sr LEFT JOIN user u ON sr.student_id = u.id WHERE sr.status = #{status} ORDER BY sr.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM song_request WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT sr.*, u.id as user_id, u.real_name, u.student_id FROM song_request sr LEFT JOIN user u ON sr.student_id = u.id WHERE sr.status = 'pending' ORDER BY sr.create_time ASC
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM song_request GROUP BY status
